objective: Hold four bases at the same time in Arathi Basin, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.

description: <name>, as the battles over Arathi Basin rage, news of your actions have reached many ears.  You are highly regarded among us, which gives me confidence that you will accomplish the mission I now have for you.

It is time to send a message to the League of Arathor.  We must show them that their holdings in Arathi Basin are tenuous and quickly lost.  We will show them this by holding, all at once, four strategic points in Arathi Basin.
Succeed in this, <name>, and earn great respect among the Defilers.
